svg.text: One Compose project (scenarios/gaiax-compliance/compose.yaml): the data space's portitor-issuer, three Portitor participants, and a local Gaia-X compliance service in test mode (examples/gaiax/compliance.yaml). The
tls service answers for the *.gaiax.test names over HTTPS with a test CA made for each run; the test notary's credentials are written by run.sh.
